src/Disks/DiskObjectStorage/MetadataStorages/ContentAddressed/Pool/CasPartWriteTxn.h:69,139-141 show dedup is entirely hash-identity based (a `DeduplicationCacheHit` requires the same content-hash key and a HEAD-first confirmed live incarnation); since CAS blob identity is the content hash of the exact byte stream (CasLayout.cpp `blobKey`/`blobHexOf`), two independently recomputed byte streams that differ at the byte level (different compression framing, codec choice, or a TTL `now()` literal) hash differently and therefore cannot hit this cache -- only literally-identical bytes shared from one already-uploaded blob (e.g. a replica fetching another's part) dedup.
